title: AI Metadata Inspector — Windows Metadata Viewer
summary: A portable Windows utility designed to extract and view generation metadata, including prompts and seeds, from AI-generated images and videos without opening generation software.
research_notes: Includes Windows Explorer context menu integration and allows direct export of ComfyUI JSON workflows.

evolution.summary: The tool expanded from a basic PNG metadata viewer to include MP4 video support, frame extraction via bundled FFmpeg, and detection of multi-pass workflows for complex pipelines like WAN and img2vid.
